title: Software Publishers
peers: CMG DCBO DSG DTOL ENGH KXS LSPD OTEX SHOP TCS BB CVO
note: COPS projects only Information and cultural industries as a whole (NAICS 51), so its figure is broader than software. Peers: every listed Canadian company Onesheet files under Software - Application or Software - Infrastructure, except the candidates.

title: Engineering Services
note: StatCan, COPS and BLS publish architectural, engineering and related services (5413) together. Peers: the Engineering & Construction companies whose Onesheet profile describes engineering services (Stantec, AtkinsRéalis), not contractors.

title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
note: Published as management, scientific and technical consulting (5416). COPS groups it with advertising, design and other professional services. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Other Management Consulting Services
note: Same series as 541611.

title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
note: Same series as 541611.

title: Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction
note: StatCan splits construction by type of work, not by NAICS: 'Engineering and other construction activities' (23X) is the civil-engineering part. COPS and BLS publish construction (23) as a whole. Peers: the Engineering & Construction companies whose Onesheet profile describes construction work (Bird, Badger).

title: Utility System Construction
note: Same series as 237.

title: Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction
note: Same series as 237.

title: Industrial Building Construction
note: StatCan: non-residential building construction (23B). COPS and BLS: construction (23) as a whole.

title: Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance
note: StatCan publishes repair and maintenance except automotive (811A); COPS publishes repair and maintenance (811) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Truck Transportation
note: Peers: Onesheet's Trucking industry except TFI (only Mullen Group remains).

title: General Freight Trucking, Long-Distance, Less Than Truckload
note: Same series as 484: no source publishes less-than-truckload on its own.

title: Couriers and Express Delivery Services
note: No listed Canadian peer.

title: Freight Transportation Arrangement
note: StatCan and COPS: support activities for transportation (488). BLS combines scenic and sightseeing transportation with support activities (487-488). No listed Canadian peer.

title: Support Activities for Air Transportation
note: Same series as 488510: no source publishes airport operations on its own.

title: Electric Power Generation, Transmission and Distribution
peers: BEP.UN CPX EMA FTS H NPI PIF TA
note: COPS publishes utilities (22) as a whole. Peers: every listed Canadian company Onesheet files under Regulated Electric, Independent Power Producers or Renewable Utilities.

title: Nonresidential Building Construction
note: StatCan: non-residential building construction (23B). COPS and BLS publish construction (23) as a whole. Peers: the listed Canadian contractors (Bird, Badger).

title: Manufacturing
note: COPS publishes manufacturing only by sub-industry, with no total. No peer group: manufacturing is too broad.

title: Ambulatory Health Care Services
note: Healthcare software and consulting mostly serve practices and clinics. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Hospitals
note: BLS splits private and state/local hospitals; the private series (the larger) is used. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services
note: COPS groups travel arrangement with all management, administrative and support services (55, 56). No listed Canadian peer.

title: Nondepository Credit Intermediation
note: Mortgage lending outside banks. COPS: finance and banking (521-523); BLS: credit intermediation (521-522). No peer group.

title: Finance and Insurance
note: COPS publishes finance and banking (IN42) and insurance separately; finance and banking is used. No peer group.

title: Public Administration
note: BLS: state and local government excluding education and hospitals, the level that buys local-government and public-safety software. No peer group.

title: Broadcasting and Content Providers
note: COPS and BLS publish broader groups (information and culture; publishing, broadcasting and content). No peer group.

title: Educational Services
note: COPS publishes schools, colleges and universities separately, with no total. BLS: state and local education, where school software is sold. No peer group.

title: Transportation and Warehousing
note: COPS publishes transportation by mode only, with no total. No peer group.

title: Motor Vehicle and Parts Dealers
note: Automotive vertical software is sold mainly to dealers. COPS: retail trade as a whole. No peer group.

title: Legal Services
note: COPS: legal, accounting and related services (5411-5412). No peer group.

title: Real Estate
note: COPS: real estate and rental and leasing (53). No peer group.

title: Environmental Consulting Services
note: Same series as 541611: StatCan and BLS publish management, scientific and technical consulting (5416); COPS groups it with advertising, design and other professional services. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Waste Management and Remediation Services
note: StatCan publishes 562 as a whole; COPS groups it with management, administrative and support services (55, 56); BLS has no series in the file. Onesheet's Waste Management industry holds only candidates (GFL, Waste Connections), so no peer.

title: Specialty Trade Contractors
note: StatCan splits construction by type of work, not by trade, so the construction total (23) is used; COPS and BLS publish construction (23) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Automotive Body, Paint, and Interior Repair and Maintenance
note: StatCan publishes automotive repair and maintenance (8111); COPS and BLS publish repair and maintenance (811) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer: AutoCanada is a car dealer.

title: Convenience Retailers
note: StatCan publishes food and beverage retailers (445); COPS publishes retail trade as a whole; BLS has no retail series in the file. No listed Canadian convenience-store peer; the grocers are a different format.

title: Gasoline Stations and Fuel Dealers
note: StatCan publishes 457 as a whole; COPS publishes retail trade as a whole; BLS has no retail series in the file. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Hardware Merchant Wholesalers
note: StatCan uses Canadian NAICS, where hardware wholesale sits in building material and supplies merchant wholesalers (416); COPS publishes wholesale trade as a whole; BLS has no wholesale series in the file. Peers: the Industrial - Distribution companies that wholesale building products (ADENTRA, Doman).

title: Computer Systems Design and Related Services
note: StatCan and COPS publish computer systems design and related services (5415) on its own. No listed Canadian peer outside the candidates.

title: Restaurants and Other Eating Places
note: StatCan publishes food services and drinking places (722); COPS groups 7223-7225. Peers: every listed Canadian company Onesheet files under Restaurants, except the candidates.

title: Food Manufacturing
note: COPS groups food with beverage and tobacco manufacturing (3111-3123). Peers: Onesheet's Packaged Foods except Jamieson Wellness (supplements), plus Rogers Sugar (Food Confectioners).

title: Food Merchant Wholesalers
note: NAICS Canada code (US NAICS 4244). StatCan publishes food, beverage and tobacco merchant wholesalers (413); COPS publishes wholesale trade (41) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Air Transportation
note: Peers: Onesheet's Airlines, Airports & Air Services except Exchange Income.

title: Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing
note: StatCan and COPS publish fabricated metal product manufacturing (332) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Navigational, Measuring, Electromedical, and Control Instruments Manufacturing
note: StatCan and COPS publish computer and electronic product manufacturing (334) as a whole, so the series is broader than instruments. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing
note: Peers: every listed Canadian company Onesheet files under Electrical Equipment & Parts (Ballard, Electrovaya, Hammond Power).

title: Electrical Equipment Manufacturing
note: StatCan and COPS publish electrical equipment, appliance and component manufacturing (335) as a whole. Peer: Hammond Power (transformers), the only Electrical Equipment & Parts company making this kind of equipment.

title: Aerospace Product and Parts Manufacturing
note: Peers: the Aerospace & Defense companies whose Onesheet profile describes aircraft, aerostructures or spacecraft (Bombardier, Magellan, MDA Space), not simulators (CAE) or circuit boards (Firan).

title: Motor Vehicle Parts Manufacturing
note: COPS groups motor vehicles, bodies and parts (3361-3363). Peers: Onesheet's Auto - Parts.

title: Machinery Manufacturing
note: Peers: Onesheet's Industrial - Machinery and Agricultural - Machinery (ATS, Savaria, Ag Growth).

title: Insurance Agencies and Brokerages
note: StatCan publishes no insurance-brokerage series, so finance and insurance (52) is used; its 'Other finance and insurance' (52E) aggregate may be closer. COPS: insurance and funds (5241-5269). No listed Canadian peer.

title: Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing
note: StatCan and COPS publish 334 as a whole; no BLS series in the file. Peers: Celestica, the only listed Canadian company Onesheet files under Hardware, Equipment & Parts.

title: Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing
note: StatCan and COPS publish aerospace product and parts manufacturing (3364) as a whole; no BLS series in the file. Peers: the Aerospace & Defense companies that make aircraft parts (Magellan, Firan); Bombardier (aircraft), CAE (training) and MDA (space) are left out.

title: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
note: StatCan and COPS use Canadian NAICS, where wholesale trade is 41 and recreational goods wholesalers sit in personal and household goods (414); COPS publishes wholesale trade as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: Warm Air Heating and Air-Conditioning Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
note: StatCan and COPS use Canadian NAICS, where wholesale trade is 41 and heating and air-conditioning wholesalers sit in building material and supplies (416); COPS publishes wholesale trade as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.

title: In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing
note: StatCan publishes pharmaceutical and medicine manufacturing (3254), which includes diagnostic substances; COPS and BLS publish chemical manufacturing (325) as a whole. No listed Canadian peer.
